summary: Highview is a multi-award-winning Victorian and Queensland accounting, financial planning, finance, insurance and bookkeeping group with seven offices and a 150+ strong team. Carlia Morgan has been a Highview Partner since Oct 2023, leading the Bass Coast office (opened 2024), which added Korumburra and Warragul locations in Aug 2026. The Mornington office advertised in Oct 2026 for a Bookkeeping Manager to review the team's BAS and reconciliations.

hooks.text: Carlia says time management and overseeing the office is the biggest learning curve of running Bass Coast, and the office just expanded to Korumburra and Warragul; reconciliation is a natural time drain to remove.
Mornington is hiring a Bookkeeping Manager whose job is to review BAS and reconciliations: a direct pain point Vert addresses (third angle for the final nudge).
Fast expansion (Bass Coast 2024, Frankston and Gold Coast 2025, Gippsland 2026) multiplies books to reconcile across offices.

risks.text: Two earlier emails (16 and 23 Nov 2026) are unanswered; a third touch should be short, add a new angle and offer an easy out.
Larger firm (150+ staff) with several Bookkeeping Managers and possible existing tooling (FYI Elite mentioned in the job ad); the buyer may sit at Head Office (Cranbourne) rather than at Bass Coast.
Carlia's Bass Coast office is a regional office; the Mornington bookkeeping team is the more direct user of Vert.

gaps: No podcast, video or personal LinkedIn posts by Carlia found beyond firm blog quotes.
No direct evidence of reconciliation or AI tools beyond FYI Elite and Xero/MYOB/QuickBooks mentions.
The Bookkeeping Manager ad copy is from an aggregator (Jobstralia); the firm's own posting page was not read.
